brand.name: Wanderlush Egypt
brand.shortDescription: Explore Egyptian destinations, choose curated experiences, build a personalised itinerary and see a transparent estimate before you request a booking.

home.heroSupport: Choose the places, pick the experiences, and shape a day-by-day journey with a price that updates as you go.
home.heroSearch: Where do you want to go?
home.searchHint: Start typing a place, or browse all ten.
home.mapLabel: Map of Egypt with selectable destinations

destinations.title: Ten places worth the journey
destinations.lead: From the Giza plateau to a chalk desert with no light for two hundred kilometres. Each one says how long it deserves and what a day actually costs.

map.title: Egypt is bigger than the map suggests
map.lead: Cairo to Aswan is a two-hour flight. Siwa is eight hours from the coast. Choose a place to see what it holds and how long it takes to reach.

journeys.title: Journeys we would book ourselves
journeys.lead: Six routes built around how Egypt actually travels. Take one as it is, or open it in the trip builder and make it yours.

experiences.title: The experiences people remember
experiences.lead: A balloon over the Valley of the Kings, four nights on the river, a night under the chalk formations, a wall of coral that drops into open blue.

promises.title: Planning that behaves like a person
promises.lead: No account, no payment, no pressure. Build the trip, see the estimate move, and send it when it looks right.

testimonials.title: What people say afterwards
testimonials.note: Demonstration content for a fictional company. These travellers are invented.

cta.body: Pick a destination, add the experiences you want, and watch the estimate settle. It takes about five minutes and commits you to nothing.

footer.rights: A fictional travel company, built as a portfolio project.
footer.demoNotice: All destinations, experiences, prices and testimonials on this site are demonstration content.

booking.title: Request your booking

confirmation.title: Your request is in

contact.title: Talk to a travel specialist

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
